Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the second
respondent to consider and decide the representation of the petitioners dated 13.5.2024 and
31.5.2024 as per report of revenue officials dated 1.1.2024 and also to disburse compensation to the
petitioners in terms of award dated 15.5.2021 for an area measuring 311 sq. meters of Khasra No.
1209, acquired by respondent nos. 1 to 3 under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.
Ankur Goel And Another vs Project Director National Highway ... on 11 September, 2024

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners have raised two grievances.

The first one is in relation to non-disbursement of compensation amount in terms of award dated 15.5.2021 for an area measuring 311 sq. meters of Khasra No. 1209 and the second one is in relation to occupation of excess area over and above the area acquired while executing the project.

In this behalf, the petitioners place reliance on report of revenue officials dated 1.1.2024, according to which, the road was found to be constructed over an area of 521 sq. meters instead of 311 sq. meters, i.e. over an excess area of 210 sq. meters.
3. In the written instructions furnished by competent authority, it is unequivocally admitted that excess area measuring 210 sq. meters has been utilized in construction of road without acquisition.
4. Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for NHAI, submits that the compensation amount in terms of award is in deposit with competent authority.

5. Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, submits that the competent authority would disburse the compensation amount for the said area to the petitioners after verifying their claim.

6. In respect of 210 sq. meters of land which was found to have been utilized in constructing the road without acquisition, Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel appearing for NHAI and Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, submit that the matter be referred to the District Level Committee for quantifying the compensation amount in terms of G.O. dated 12.5.2016.

7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of as follows: -
(a) The competent authority will take decision for disbursement of compensation in respect of 311 sq. meters of land within a period of three weeks from the date of communication of the instant order;
(b) The petitioners will make a fresh representation along with true attested copy of the instant order before the District Magistrate (respondent no. 3) and he will transmit the representation to the District Level Committee for being decided in terms of G.O. dated 12.5.2016, after due notice and opportunity of hearing to all concerned.
(Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 11.9.2024 Jaideep/-
